units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 74a">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>שקליתה לסִילְּתָאִי וכ׳</he> I took off my basket with provision &c.

<cite ref="Pesachim 111b:12">Pes. 111ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>תלא סִילְּתֵיה תלא מזוניה</he> (ed. <cite ref="O00678"><he>סילתא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) he who suspends his bread-basket (in the air), suspends his sustenance (brings poverty into the house).
